title: refactor-sprite-inpaint job input
description: The object sent as {"input": ...} to the RunPod endpoint. Generated from src/sprite_inpaint/schema.py - do not edit by hand.

image.description: The approved sprite. 8-bit PNG, RGBA or RGB. Base64 PNG (raw or data URI) or an https:// URL the worker downloads.

mask.description: Edit mask, same size as image. Non-black, non-transparent pixels are repainted; brightness sets strength (max(R,G,B) x alpha). Pixels with mask value 0 are returned byte-for-byte unchanged. Base64 PNG (raw or data URI) or an https:// URL the worker downloads.

guide_image.description: Optional pose/geometry guide, same size (or same aspect) as image: an OpenPose-style skeleton, scribble, line art, MLSD, depth or gray map drawn in the image's coordinates. Base64 PNG (raw or data URI) or an https:// URL the worker downloads.

alpha_image.description: Optional target silhouette for alpha_mode 'provided' / 'provided_glow'. Uses its alpha channel if it has one, otherwise its brightness. Base64 PNG (raw or data URI) or an https:// URL the worker downloads.

prompt.description: Correction prompt describing what the masked area should become.

negative_prompt.description: Only used when cfg > 1 (Z-Image-Turbo ignores negatives at cfg 1).

guide_preprocess.description: 'none' = guide is already a control map; 'canny' = run ComfyUI's Canny on it first.

control_strength.description: Fun ControlNet strength (model card: 0.65-1.0; higher helps inpaint continuity).

seed.description: -1 picks a random seed; the seed used is returned.

steps.description: Sampling steps (the 8-step distilled ControlNet is tuned for 8).

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance. Z-Image-Turbo is distilled for 1.0.

denoise.description: 1.0 regenerates the masked area; lower keeps more of the original there.

diffusion_precision.description: Diffusion model weights in VRAM: bf16 (12.3 GB, best quality) or fp8 (about half; use if a 24 GB GPU runs short or for faster cold starts).

work_megapixels.description: Area the cropped region is resized to for generation. Only the crop around the mask is generated, never the whole sprite unless the mask spans it.

max_upscale.description: Cap on how much a small crop is enlarged for generation.

context_padding_px.description: Minimum context added around the mask bounding box, in source pixels.

context_padding_ratio.description: Context added around the mask box as a fraction of its longer side (the larger of the two paddings wins).

mask_grow_px.description: Dilation of the mask the MODEL sees (source pixels). Does not widen what is composited.

feather_px.description: Inward feather of the composite edge. Never extends outside the mask.

matte_color.description: Background the sprite is flattened onto for the model, and keyed out of the result.

alpha_mode.description: Alpha of repainted pixels. auto (default) = 'provided' when alpha_image is given, otherwise 'key_add'. provided = alpha_image exactly (precise part repairs with a known silhouette); key_add = max(original alpha, keyed alpha) (extend limbs, keeps glows); preserve = original alpha; key = keyed alpha only (can erase); provided_glow = max(alpha_image, keyed alpha).

alpha_key_knee.description: Keyed alpha = clamp(max |pixel - matte| / knee). Lower = more opaque.

return_format.description: 'full' returns the whole PNG; 'patch' returns only the crop box (client pastes it back).

return_debug.description: Also return the model-space source, mask, guide and raw generation.
